scope.change: Exercise direct note selection through the Note to inspect ComboBox in a two-note existing vault, using an AccessKit click action to open the control.
checks: Starting with README.md selected, resolved link/embed results and its source preview visible, activate Note to inspect and select Notes/Welcome.md.
The selection updates the canonical note path and clears old link status/resolutions/errors, embed report/error, source preview/receiver/error and inline image textures.
Preview the newly selected note byte-for-byte; full vault and separate app-data snapshots remain unchanged before and after UI teardown.
fixture_contents: The existing-vault fixture supplies README.md and Notes/Welcome.md and includes two resolvable README note links/embeds.
The test derives both selected paths from the opened VaultSession so the queried option label follows the runner's native path display.
Vault and separate app-data snapshots are taken before opening the session.
scope.harness_boundary: The synthetic egui harness invokes AccessKit Action::Click on the Note to inspect ComboBox and selects the exposed option. This verifies semantic UI activation and state behavior; it is not an OS screen-reader test, native folder-picker test, or Obsidian reference-app round trip.

ci.conclusion: All seven required GitHub Actions workflows and every job passed on exact source SHA f1d759ef94c92fa7d1af945b0697e36eb76c974f. The focused test passed on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
rust_gates: Ubuntu cargo fmt --all -- --check passed on the corrected source SHA; macOS and Windows formatting steps are skipped by workflow design.
Workspace tests and the Rust parallel preflight group passed on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows; the focused ComboBox test appears and passed in all three platform logs.
Clippy, crate dependency-layer checks and native preview builds passed on all three platforms.
The unchanged PC05 and PC08 Wry feasibility probes completed on all three platforms; these reports remain feasibility-only and do not certify plugin isolation.

attempts.conclusion: Focused test passed on Ubuntu and macOS; Windows workspace tests failed because the test queried Notes/Welcome.md while the Windows AccessKit label used the native backslash path. All six companion workflows passed.
attempts.correction: Used Path::display() for the option label; the follow-up showed the fixture-created PathBuf retained slash separators on Windows.

attempts.conclusion: Focused test passed on Ubuntu and macOS; Windows workspace tests still could not find the note option. The Windows Accessibility tree showed the inspector ComboBox remained closed after a pointer-center click, and the option path label came from a slash-preserving fixture PathBuf. All six companion workflows passed.
attempts.correction: Activate the ComboBox with AccessKit Action::Click and derive relative note paths from VaultSession entries.

attempts.conclusion: Focused workspace test passed on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows. Ubuntu rustfmt requested the chained AccessKit click to fit on one line; the Ubuntu parallel group failed only on formatting. All six companion workflows passed.
attempts.correction: Applied the exact one-line rustfmt layout.

attempts.conclusion: All seven workflows and every job passed; the focused test passed on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
